scope.goal: Track SDK consumer bundler compatibility for productization.

cases.notes: Tarball-installed consumer imports @cargo-container/sdk root types and validates stable API surface.
Tarball-installed consumer verifies CommonJS conditional export exposes createContainer, createPreviewRelay, and protocolVersion.
Tarball-installed Vite consumer imports the root SDK package, builds successfully, and verifies worker asset URL strings survive bundling.

cases.productGap: Webpack is not installed in the root dev toolchain yet. Add a fixture that verifies conditional exports, worker assets, and wasm asset handling.
Rspack is not installed in the root dev toolchain yet. Add a fixture that mirrors the Webpack asset checks.
Next is not installed in the root dev toolchain yet. Add a browser-client-only fixture and document required transpilation/asset config.

gate.reason: TypeScript bundler resolution, CJS require, and Vite consumer build smoke pass, but Webpack/Rspack/Next consumer builds are not implemented yet.
requiredToPass: Add Webpack SDK consumer build smoke
Add Rspack SDK consumer build smoke
Add Next SDK consumer build smoke
Document automatic and manual Worker/WASM asset handling per bundler
